title: Execution Requirement Readiness
description: Experimental (`media_buy.execution_readiness`). Whether the caller's account can satisfy one entry of a product's `execution_requirements[]`. Account-scoped; appears only in the `get_products` `execution_readiness` map and MUST NOT be disclosed across accounts. Advisory: `create_media_buy` revalidates.

requirement.description: The product's declared requirement, echoed. MUST deep-equal an entry of its current `execution_requirements[]`; no match means the buyer's product feed is stale.

readiness_status.description: Readiness of this requirement. For `downstream_connection`, derived from `connection_state.status`: `connected` and `not_required` are `ready`; `missing`, `pending`, `expired`, `revoked` are `setup_required`; `unknown` is `unknown`. `selection_required` and `input_required` apply only to `event_source` and `catalog`.

binding_field.description: Where the buyer binds the resource, in the form of `error.field`. Omitted for `downstream_connection`. For `event_source` and `catalog`, SHOULD be present when `ready` or `selection_required`.

resolved.description: The resource to use when `readiness_status` is `ready`, for `event_source` and `catalog`; REQUIRED then. The buyer MUST still bind `resource_id`: `ready` does not waive binding (`not_bound` per `error-details/execution-requirement-unmet.json`).

resource_id.description: Directly usable in `binding_field`: the `event_source_id` from `sync_event_sources` (including a seller-managed source) or a `catalog_id`. Never a raw platform ID unless that is what the field accepts.

name.description: Human-readable name of the resource on the seller's platform.

candidates.description: Resources the account has, when `selection_required`, for `event_source` and `catalog`. Account-scoped, never disclosed across accounts. Lists resources the seller has no evidence would fail the requirement; MAY include one whose event types or catalog type it cannot verify.

name.description: Human-readable name of the resource on the seller's platform.

connection_state.description: For `downstream_connection`, REQUIRED: the account's state for the connection the seller would use (its documented default when several are connected). Reuses `downstream-connection-requirement.json` as a state record; only `status`, `provider`, `connection_type`, `scope`, `authorization_url`, `authorization_instructions`, and `connection_id` are meaningful here. `missing`, `expired`, or `revoked` SHOULD carry `authorization_url` or `authorization_instructions`; `connection_id` only when safe to disclose to this account.

unknown_reason.description: Why the seller could not check; REQUIRED when `unknown`. `permission_denied`: its credential cannot read this resource kind. `platform_unavailable`: the read failed or timed out. `not_evaluated`: skipped, for example past its evaluation budget.

issues.description: Actionable detail for a non-`ready` status. SHOULD be limited to the 3-5 most actionable items.
